LMD Trading Operations Center

Live trading dashboard · Tradovate Position History · Eastern futures day 18:00–17:00

Live data loads from data/live.json when available; embedded Eastern-time corrected snapshot is retained as a fallback. Trade P&L uses Position History with execution fees matched from Cash History; unmatched fees are disclosed below. Return % is calculated from fee-adjusted trade P&L divided by starting capital plus deposits ($3,144.92), as shown in your Cash_Flows sheet; it may differ from the Google dashboard until P&L and fees are reconciled. Tradovate fixed-EST source timestamps are converted to Eastern time with daylight saving before publication. Research data is never included in live metrics.
